two_sum.optimal:
seen = empty dict value -> index
for each index i:
    need = target - nums[i]
    if need is in seen:
        return [seen[need], i]
    seen[nums[i]] = i   (insert after the lookup so an element never pairs with itself)
return []

majority_element.optimal:
candidate = nums[0], count = 0
for each value in nums:
    if count == 0:
        candidate = value   (the previous candidate was fully cancelled out)
    if value == candidate: count += 1
    else: count -= 1
return candidate

valid_sudoku.optimal:
rows, cols, boxes = 9 empty sets each
for each cell (row, col) on the board:
    digit = board[row][col]
    if digit is '.': skip
    box = (row // 3) * 3 + col // 3   (which of the nine 3x3 boxes, numbered 0..8)
    if digit is in rows[row] or in cols[col] or in boxes[box]:
        return False
    add digit to rows[row], cols[col] and boxes[box]
return True

group_anagrams.optimal:
buckets = empty dict letter-count signature -> list of words
for each word in strs:
    counts = 26 zeros
    for each letter ch in word:
        counts[position of ch in the alphabet] += 1
    key = counts as a tuple   (anagrams share the exact same histogram)
    if key not in buckets: buckets[key] = empty list
    append word to buckets[key]
return the lists in buckets

top_k_frequent_elements.brute:
freq = count of each value in nums
pairs = empty list
for each value in freq:
    append (freq[value], value) to pairs
sort pairs from highest frequency to lowest
result = empty list
for i from 0 to k - 1:
    append the value of pairs[i] to result
return result

product_of_array_except_self.optimal:
answer = n ones
prefix = 1
for i from 0 to n - 1:
    answer[i] = prefix   (product of everything left of i: stamp first, then include i)
    prefix = prefix * nums[i]
suffix = 1
for i from n - 1 down to 0:
    answer[i] = answer[i] * suffix   (times the product of everything right of i)
    suffix = suffix * nums[i]
return answer

longest_consecutive_sequence.brute:
best = 0
for each start in nums:
    length = 1
    while start + length is in nums:   (each membership test scans the whole list)
        length += 1
    best = max(best, length)
return best

subarray_sum_equals_k.optimal:
counts = dict prefix sum -> times seen, starting as {0: 1}   (the empty prefix)
prefix = 0, answer = 0
for each value in nums:
    prefix += value
    answer += counts[prefix - k], or 0 if absent   (each earlier prefix at prefix - k ends a k-sum here)
    counts[prefix] += 1
return answer

valid_palindrome.brute:
cleaned = empty string
for each character ch in s:
    if ch is a letter or digit: append lowercase ch to cleaned
return cleaned == reverse of cleaned
valid_palindrome.optimal:
left = 0, right = n - 1
while left < right:
    while left < right and s[left] is not a letter or digit: left += 1   (filter lazily, on the fly)
    while left < right and s[right] is not a letter or digit: right -= 1
    if lowercase s[left] != lowercase s[right]: return False
    left += 1, right -= 1
return True

sort_colors.brute:
counts = [0, 0, 0]
for each value in nums: counts[value] += 1
i = 0
for each colour 0, 1, 2:
    repeat counts[colour] times:
        nums[i] = colour
        i += 1

container_with_most_water.brute:
best = 0
for each pair of walls i < j:
    area = min(height[i], height[j]) * (j - i)   (the water level is the shorter wall)
    best = max(best, area)
return best
container_with_most_water.optimal:
left = 0, right = n - 1, best = 0
while left < right:
    area = min(height[left], height[right]) * (right - left)
    best = max(best, area)
    if height[left] < height[right]: left += 1   (the shorter wall can never be part of a better pair)
    else: right -= 1
return best
